These JSON fixtures define the Edge Sync Contract v1 request/response shapes for every supported endpoint. Each file follows the schema `{ "name", "request": { "method", "path", "headers", "body"|"multipart" }, "response": { "status", "body" }, "preconditions" }`. The fixtures are consumed by the contract test suite (`pytest -m edge_contract`) which replays each request against a scratch server started with `python scripts/edge_scratch_server.py` and asserts the status code and key response fields match. They are also the single source of truth for client SDK authors implementing the edge sync protocol.
